facts: The police held him overnight. What does personal liberty say?
A tribunal decided his case in private. What does fair hearing require?
Someone opened his letters and listened to telephone conversations. What about private and family life?
A paper was stopped from publishing. What does freedom of expression say?
He wants to change his religion and worship with others. What does freedom of religion say?
A citizen was told he cannot reside in another state. What does freedom of movement say?
She was refused a public post because of her sex. What does freedom from discrimination say?
The government took possession of his immovable property. What does compulsory acquisition say?
He was tortured while detained. What does dignity of the human person say?
Someone threatened to deprive him of his life. What does the right to life say?
People want to form a trade union and assemble. What does peaceful assembly say?
He wants to ask a High Court for legal aid after a right was contravened.
What does the Constitution say about democracy and social justice?
Example words of a target apply in this situation.
